passages.title: 雨天的故事書
passages.text: It rained all day on Saturday, so my little brother and I could not go out. "I'm bored," he said. "Can you tell me a {1}?" I did not have any books with me, so I made one up. It was about a cat that could fly. Every night, the cat {2} home and flew to the moon to eat cheese. My brother listened carefully. When I stopped, he shouted, "Don't stop! What happened next?" So I kept going. The cat met a rabbit, a lost robot, and a very sleepy dragon. By dinner time, the story was {3} not finished. Then my brother had an {4}: "Let's draw pictures for it!" We {5} crayons and paper to make a little book. Now it is our favorite book, and we read it together on every rainy day.

blanks.why: tell + 人 + a story「講故事給某人聽」。idea 前面要用 an，news 不可數不能加 a，business 也不能「講」。
leave home「離開家」：那隻貓每晚離開家飛到月球。used、enjoyed、planned home 意思都不通。
still「仍然」：到晚餐時間故事還沒說完 still not finished。enough、during 不能這樣用；even 要放在 not 後面（not even）。
have an idea「有個點子」。前面是 an，story、plan、kind 都要用 a，而且意思也不對。
use + 物 + to + 原形動詞「用…來做…」：我們用蠟筆和紙做成一本小書。left、called、felt crayons 都不通。

passages.zh: 星期六下了一整天的雨，我和弟弟都不能出門。「好無聊喔，」他說，「你可以講個故事給我聽嗎？」我手邊沒有書，就自己編了一個。故事是關於一隻會飛的貓，每天晚上，牠都會離開家，飛到月球上吃起司。弟弟聽得好專心。我一停下來，他就大喊：「別停！後來呢？」於是我繼續講下去。那隻貓遇到了一隻兔子、一個迷路的機器人，還有一條很愛睏的龍。到了晚餐時間，故事還是沒講完。這時弟弟想到一個點子：「我們幫故事畫圖吧！」我們用蠟筆和紙做成一本小書。現在這是我們最喜歡的書，每到下雨天就一起讀。

passages.title: 爺爺學用智慧型手機
passages.text: Grandpa has had the {1} phone for fifteen years. It is small and heavy, and it can only make calls. "Why don't you get a smartphone?" I asked him. "It is too {2} to use," he said. So I decided to help him. Every Sunday, I showed him how to {3} the apps on my old smartphone. At first, he forgot everything I taught him. But he did not give up. He wrote all the steps in a little notebook. After two months, he could send photos and make video {4}. Now he talks to my aunt in Canada every week, and he can see her face! He even sends me funny stickers {5} my lunch break. Sometimes I have to tell him, "Grandpa, I'm in class!"

blanks.why: the same + 名詞「同一個…」：爺爺同一支手機用了十五年。likely、kind、during phone 都不通。
too + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞「太…而不能…」：太難用了。same、enough、during 都不能放在 too 後面。
use the apps「使用應用程式」。leave、feel、pay the apps 都不通。
make a video call「打視訊電話」。make video ideas、uses、kinds 都不是正確說法。
during + 時間「在…期間」：在我午休的時候。than、because 後面不能直接接名詞表時間，still 是副詞，也不能接名詞。

passages.zh: 爺爺同一支手機已經用了十五年。它又小又重，只能打電話。「你為什麼不換一支智慧型手機？」我問他。「太難用了。」他說。於是我決定幫他。每個星期天，我教他用我那支舊智慧型手機上的應用程式。一開始，他把我教的全都忘了，但他沒有放棄，還把每個步驟都寫在小筆記本裡。兩個月後，他會傳照片，也會打視訊電話了。現在他每週都和住在加拿大的阿姨通話，還能看到她的臉！他甚至會在我午休的時候傳好笑的貼圖給我。有時候我得跟他說：「爺爺，我在上課啦！」

passages.title: 雙胞胎的惡作劇
passages.text: Amy and Zoe are twins. They have the {1} face, the same hair, and the same voice. Even their mom sometimes {2} Amy "Zoe." One day, the twins had a plan. They changed seats in class. Zoe sat in Amy's seat, and Amy sat in Zoe's. The teacher did not notice. {3} the math class, the teacher asked "Amy" a hard question, and Zoe answered it right away. Zoe is good at math, but Amy is not. "Wow, Amy, you are getting better!" the teacher said. The real Amy laughed so {4} that she fell off her chair. Then the teacher understood everything. Now the twins have to sit in their own seats, but their classmates {5} talk about that funny day.

blanks.why: the same + 名詞「一樣的…」：她們長得一模一樣。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。
call + 人 + 名字「叫某人…」：媽媽有時會把 Amy 叫成 Zoe。uses、leaves、pays Amy "Zoe" 都不通。
during + 時段「在…期間」：在數學課的時候。Because 後面要接句子，Than、About 放在這裡意思不通。
laugh hard「大笑、笑得很用力」：笑到從椅子上摔下來。same、still、during 都不能修飾 laughed so …。
still「仍然、到現在還」：同學們到現在還在聊那天的事。enough、during、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: Amy 和 Zoe 是雙胞胎，她們有一樣的臉、一樣的頭髮，連聲音都一樣，就連媽媽有時都會把 Amy 叫成「Zoe」。有一天，雙胞胎想了一個計畫：她們在班上交換座位，Zoe 坐 Amy 的位子，Amy 坐 Zoe 的位子，老師完全沒發現。數學課時，老師問「Amy」一個很難的問題，Zoe 馬上就答出來了。Zoe 數學很好，但 Amy 不太行。「哇，Amy，你進步了耶！」老師說。真正的 Amy 笑得太用力，從椅子上摔了下來，老師這才恍然大悟。現在雙胞胎得坐回自己的位子，但同學們到現在還在聊那有趣的一天。

passages.title: 颱風夜的手影戲
passages.text: A strong typhoon hit Taiwan last week. The government said schools and offices would be closed, so we did not have to {1} home. {2} the typhoon, the wind was so strong that our windows shook all night. At about nine o'clock, the power went out. My little sister was scared and started to cry. So my dad {3} a flashlight to make animal shadows on the wall: a dog, a bird, and a funny rabbit. She laughed and forgot about the storm. The next morning, the rain had stopped, but the streets were {4} wet, and many trees were lying on the road. My family went out to help our neighbors clean up. It was {5} work, but everyone helped each other, and we finished before lunch.

blanks.why: leave home「出門、離開家」：不用出門上學上班。use、feel、pay home 都不通。
during + 名詞「在…期間」：颱風期間風很大。Because 後面要接句子，Than、About 放在這裡不通。
use + 物 + to + 原形動詞「用…來做…」：爸爸用手電筒在牆上做動物影子。paid、called、felt a flashlight 都不通。
still「仍然」：雨停了，但街道還是濕的。enough wet 語序錯，same、during 不能修飾形容詞 wet。
hard work「辛苦的工作」。same work 前面要加 the，still、during 不能修飾 work。

passages.zh: 上星期，一個強烈颱風侵襲台灣。政府宣布停班停課，所以我們不用出門。颱風期間，風大到窗戶整晚都在搖。大約九點時停電了，妹妹嚇得哭了起來。於是爸爸用手電筒在牆上做出動物的影子：一隻狗、一隻鳥，還有一隻滑稽的兔子。妹妹笑了，也忘了外面的暴風雨。隔天早上，雨停了，但街道還是濕的，很多樹倒在路上。我們全家出去幫鄰居清理。雖然很辛苦，但大家互相幫忙，午餐前就整理完了。

passages.title: 長頸鹿的脖子
passages.text: When I was little, Grandma told me a {1} about giraffes. Long ago, giraffes had short necks, just like horses. Then came a very dry summer. There was not {2} grass on the ground, and all the animals were hungry. Only the tall trees {3} had green leaves at the top. One young giraffe tried very {4} to reach them. He stretched his neck every day, from morning to night. Slowly, his neck got longer and longer. His children had long necks too. Soon all the giraffes {5} their long necks to eat the leaves at the top of the trees. Now I know this is not real science, but I love it anyway. Grandma says a good story does not have to be true.

blanks.why: tell + 人 + a story「講故事給某人聽」。idea 前要用 an，news 不可數不能加 a，business 不能「講」。
not enough + 名詞「不夠的…」：地上的草不夠。same、during、still 都不能放在 not 和名詞中間。
still「仍然」：只有高高的樹上還有綠葉。enough、same、during 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。
try hard「努力嘗試」：牠非常努力地想吃到樹葉。same、enough、during 都不能接在 tried very 後面。
use + 物 + to + 原形動詞：長頸鹿用長脖子吃樹頂的葉子。left、called、felt their long necks 都不通。

passages.zh: 我小時候，奶奶講過一個關於長頸鹿的故事。很久以前，長頸鹿的脖子很短，就跟馬一樣。後來遇到一個非常乾旱的夏天，地上的草不夠吃，所有動物都餓壞了，只有高高的樹頂上還有綠葉。一隻年輕的長頸鹿非常努力地想搆到它們，從早到晚每天伸長脖子。慢慢地，牠的脖子愈來愈長，牠的孩子們也都有長脖子。很快地，所有長頸鹿都用長長的脖子吃樹頂的葉子。現在我知道這不是真正的科學，但我還是很喜歡。奶奶說，好故事不一定要是真的。

passages.title: 莫娜出海
passages.text: Moana lived on a beautiful island. Her father did not want anyone to {1} the island. "The ocean is too dangerous," he said. But the island was in trouble. The fish were gone, and the coconuts were going bad. Moana had an {2}: she would sail across the ocean and find Maui to help her. One night, she {3} quietly in a small boat with her pet chicken, Heihei. The trip was very {4}. There were big waves, strong winds, and scary monsters. Many times, she almost gave up. {5} the long trip, she also learned how to sail by watching the stars. In the end, she found Maui, and together they saved her island. Her father was very proud of her.

blanks.why: leave + 地方「離開…」：爸爸不想讓任何人離開這座島。feel、pay、become the island 都不通。
have an idea「有個點子」。前面是 an，story、plan、kind 都要用 a。
leave「離開、出發」：她在夜裡悄悄出發。used、paid 後面需要受詞，became 後面要接名詞或形容詞，都不通。
hard「艱難的」：這趟旅程很辛苦。same 前面要加 the，enough、during 都不能接在 very 後面。
during + 名詞「在…期間」：在漫長的旅途中她學會看星星航行。Because、Than、About 都不能這樣接名詞表時間。

gloss: 莫娜（迪士尼電影《海洋奇緣》的主角）
passages.zh: 莫娜住在一座美麗的小島上。她的爸爸不准任何人離開這座島：「大海太危險了。」但小島遇上了麻煩：魚都不見了，椰子也開始壞掉。莫娜想到一個辦法：她要航行越過大海，找到毛伊來幫忙。一天晚上，她帶著寵物雞嘿嘿，悄悄坐上小船出發了。這趟旅程非常艱辛，有大浪、強風，還有可怕的怪物，好幾次她都差點放棄。在漫長的旅途中，她也學會了看星星航行。最後，她找到毛伊，一起拯救了她的島。她的爸爸非常以她為榮。

passages.title: 給奶奶的手機架
passages.text: Our school has a new maker room with a 3D printer. Our teacher asked us to {1} it to make something helpful for our families. My partner Kai had a great {2}: a phone holder for his grandma. Her hands shake, so she cannot hold her phone for long. We worked {3} on it for two weeks. Our first holder was too small for the phone. The second one was the {4} size, but it broke when we put the phone in. Kai was a little sad, but we tried again. This time, we made the bottom thicker. Finally, the third one worked! When Kai gave it to his grandma, she was so happy that she {5} all her friends to tell them about it. Now she watches cooking videos every night without holding her phone.

blanks.why: use + 物 + to + 原形動詞「用…來做…」：老師要我們用 3D 印表機做東西。leave、call、feel it to make 都不通。
have a great idea「有個好點子」。news、money、homework 都是不可數名詞，不能加 a，意思也不通。
work hard「努力工作」：我們努力做了兩個星期。same、during、than 都不能修飾 worked。
the same size「一樣的大小」：第二個大小一樣，但一放手機就斷了。hard、enough、during size 都不通。
call + 人「打電話給某人」：她開心到打電話給所有朋友。used、left、paid all her friends 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們學校有一間新的創客教室，裡面有一台 3D 印表機。老師要我們用它做一個對家人有幫助的東西。我的夥伴 Kai 想到一個好點子：幫他奶奶做手機架。奶奶的手會抖，沒辦法拿手機太久。我們努力做了兩個星期。第一個架子太小，放不下手機；第二個大小一樣，但一放手機就斷了。Kai 有點難過，但我們再試一次，這次把底部做得更厚。終於，第三個成功了！Kai 把它送給奶奶時，奶奶開心得打電話告訴所有朋友。現在她每天晚上都不用拿著手機，就能看烹飪影片了。

passages.title: 爸爸小時候的故事
passages.text: My dad likes to tell me {1} about his childhood. When he was a kid, he lived in a small village in the mountains. There was no Internet. His family did not even have a phone at home, so if they wanted to {2} someone, they had to go to the store and pay. After school, Dad {3} to catch fish in the river with his friends. They played outside until it got dark. "Weren't you bored without games and phones?" I asked. "Never," he said. "We did not have much money, but we had {4} fun." Last summer, he took me to his village. Many old houses are gone, and there is a new road. But the river is {5} there, and the water is as clear as before. We caught three fish together.

blanks.why: tell + 人 + stories「講故事給某人聽」。uses、calls、leaves 都不能「講」，意思不通。
call + 人「打電話給某人」：想打電話得到商店去付錢打。use、save、enjoy someone 都不通。
used to + 原形動詞「以前常常…」：爸爸以前常去河邊抓魚。felt to、became to、enjoyed to 都不是正確用法。
enough + 名詞「足夠的…」：雖然錢不多，但玩得很開心。same 前要加 the，during、still 不能修飾 fun。
still「仍然」：那條河還在。enough、same、during 都不能放在 is 和 there 中間。

passages.zh: 爸爸很喜歡跟我說他小時候的故事。他小時候住在山上的一個小村莊，那裡沒有網路，他家甚至連電話都沒有，想打電話得到商店去付錢打。放學後，爸爸以前常和朋友去河邊抓魚，一直玩到天黑。「沒有電玩和手機，你們不無聊嗎？」我問。「從來不會，」他說，「我們錢不多，但玩得夠開心了。」去年夏天，他帶我回他的村子。很多老房子都不見了，也多了一條新馬路，但那條河還在，河水和以前一樣清澈。我們一起抓到了三條魚。

passages.title: 企鵝寶寶布丁
passages.text: Last month, a baby penguin was born at the zoo. The zookeepers {1} her Pudding because she was round and soft. At first, Pudding could not swim. She was scared of the water and would not {2} her mother's side. When the other young penguins jumped into the pool, she just stood and watched. Every day, the zookeepers tried to help her, but it was {3} work. Then they had an {4}: they made a small pool with warm, shallow water just for her. Pudding put one foot in, then two. {5} the next week, she went into the small pool every day. Soon she was ready for the big pool. Now she swims faster than all the other penguins, and visitors love to watch her.

blanks.why: call + 人／動物 + 名字「叫…為…」：飼育員把牠取名為布丁。used、left、paid her Pudding 都不通。
leave one's side「離開某人身邊」：牠不肯離開媽媽身邊。use、call、pay her mother's side 都不通。
hard work「辛苦的工作」。same work 前面要加 the，still、during 不能修飾 work。
have an idea「想到辦法」。前面是 an，story、plan、kind 都要用 a。
during + 時段「在…期間」：接下來的一週，牠每天都下小水池。Because、Than、About 都不能這樣接時間。

passages.zh: 上個月，動物園裡誕生了一隻企鵝寶寶，因為牠圓圓軟軟的，飼育員就叫牠布丁。一開始，布丁不會游泳，牠很怕水，一直不肯離開媽媽身邊。其他小企鵝跳進水池時，牠只是站著看。飼育員每天都想辦法幫牠，但這是件辛苦的工作。後來他們想到一個辦法：專門為牠做了一個水又淺又溫暖的小水池。布丁先放進一隻腳，然後兩隻。接下來的一個星期，牠每天都下小水池，很快就準備好進大水池了。現在牠游得比其他企鵝都快，遊客都很喜歡看牠。

passages.title: 珍奶杯上的故事
passages.text: Mr. Huang has a bubble tea shop near our school. Last year, his shop was not doing well. There were five other bubble tea shops on the {1} street. He needed an {2}. One night, his daughter said, "Students love {3}. Why not put a short one on every cup?" So Mr. Huang started to write a new story every day. Some were funny, and some were a little scary. Each story stopped at the most exciting part, and the next part was on the next day's cup. Students came back every day because they wanted to know what happened next. Now his shop is the most popular one on the street. Students {4} line up for his drinks, even {5} the rainy season.

blanks.why: the same street「同一條街」：同一條街上就有五家飲料店。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。
need an idea「需要一個點子」。前面是 an，story、call、use 都要用 a（a use 不是 an use），意思也不對。
love stories「喜歡故事」：學生都愛看故事。calls、uses、kinds 意思不通。
still「仍然」：學生到現在還是排隊買。enough、same、during 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。
during + 名詞「在…期間」：就算在雨季也一樣。because 後面要接句子，than、about 放在這裡不通。

passages.zh: 黃先生在我們學校附近開了一家珍奶店。去年，他的生意不太好，因為同一條街上就有五家飲料店。他需要一個點子。一天晚上，他女兒說：「學生都愛看故事，何不在每個杯子上放一個短篇故事？」於是黃先生開始每天寫一個新故事，有的好笑，有的有點恐怖。每個故事都停在最精采的地方，下一段要看隔天的杯子。學生因為想知道後來怎麼了，每天都回來買。現在他的店是整條街最受歡迎的，就算在雨季，學生還是排隊買他的飲料。

passages.title: 會開冰箱的狗
passages.text: Our neighbor Mr. Chen has a big dog {1} Lucky. Lucky is very smart. Every morning, Mr. Chen {2} for work at seven, and Lucky stays home alone. One afternoon, I heard a strange sound from his house. I looked through the window and saw Lucky open the fridge with his paw! He took out a sausage and ate it. Then he closed the door with his nose, so nobody would know. I could not believe my eyes! When Mr. Chen came home, I told him the whole {3}. He laughed very {4}. "So that's why my sausages are always gone!" he said. "I thought I was getting old." Now he {5} a lock on his fridge. But Lucky is still trying to find a way to open it.

blanks.why: a dog called + 名字「一隻叫…的狗」。used、left、paid Lucky 都不通。
leave for work「出門上班」。uses、pays、feels for work 都不通。
tell + 人 + the whole story「把整件事告訴某人」。use、call、kind 都不能「講」。
laugh hard「大笑」：他笑得很厲害。same、still、during 都不能接在 laughed very 後面。
use a lock「使用鎖」：現在他在冰箱上加了鎖。feels、calls、pays a lock 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們的鄰居陳先生養了一隻叫 Lucky 的大狗，Lucky 非常聰明。每天早上七點，陳先生出門上班，Lucky 就自己待在家。有一天下午，我聽到他家傳出奇怪的聲音。我從窗戶看進去，竟然看到 Lucky 用腳掌打開冰箱！牠拿出一根香腸吃掉，再用鼻子把冰箱門關上，好讓沒人發現。我簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛！陳先生回家後，我把整件事告訴他，他笑得好大聲：「原來這就是我的香腸老是不見的原因！我還以為是自己老了。」現在他在冰箱上加了鎖，但 Lucky 還在想辦法打開它。

passages.title: 忘了帶鑰匙的下午
passages.text: Yesterday, I {1} my keys at school. When I got home, nobody was there. My parents were {2} at work, and my sister was at her dance class. I tried to {3} my mom, but her phone was off. It was cold and windy, and I was very hungry. I had only ten dollars in my pocket. That was not {4} money to buy dinner. I sat in front of the door and almost cried. Then Mrs. Lin from next door saw me. She invited me in and cooked hot noodles for me. We talked about her trip to Japan and looked at her photos. At six, my mom finally came home. I learned a {5} lesson that day: always check your bag before you leave school.

blanks.why: leave + 物 + 地方「把…忘在某處」：我把鑰匙忘在學校。called、paid、felt my keys 都不通。
still「仍然」：爸媽還在上班。enough、same、during 都不能放在 were 和 at work 中間。
call + 人「打電話給某人」。use、save、enjoy my mom 都不通。
enough money「足夠的錢」：十元不夠買晚餐。same 前要加 the，during、still 不能修飾 money。
a hard lesson「慘痛的教訓」。same 前要用 the，enough、still 不能這樣修飾 lesson。

passages.zh: 昨天，我把鑰匙忘在學校了。回到家時，家裡一個人都沒有：爸媽還在上班，姊姊在上舞蹈課。我想打電話給媽媽，但她的手機關機了。天氣又冷又颳風，我也好餓，口袋裡只有十塊錢，根本不夠買晚餐。我坐在門口，差點哭出來。這時隔壁的林太太看到我，請我進她家，還煮了熱騰騰的麵給我吃。我們聊她去日本的旅行，一起看她的照片。六點時，媽媽終於回來了。那天我學到一個慘痛的教訓：離開學校前一定要檢查書包。

passages.title: 營火旁的鬼故事
passages.text: {1} our class camping trip, we sat around the fire after dinner. Jack turned off his flashlight and said, "Let me tell you a scary {2}." Everyone moved closer. "Long ago, a girl got lost in these mountains, and nobody ever found her. People say you can {3} hear her crying at night." Just then, we heard a sound from the trees! Everyone screamed. Some students wanted to {4} right away and run back to the cabin. Then a small animal walked out of the bushes. It was just a raccoon dog looking for food! We all laughed, and Jack laughed the loudest. But that night, nobody wanted to sleep alone. All twelve of us slept in the {5} tent, and nobody slept well.

blanks.why: during + 名詞「在…期間」：在班級露營期間。Because 後面要接句子，Than、About 放在這裡不通。
tell a scary story「講鬼故事」。use、call、kind 都不能「講」。
still「仍然」：到現在還聽得到她的哭聲。enough、same、during 都不能放在 can 和動詞中間。
leave「離開」：有些同學想馬上離開。use、feel、pay right away 都不通。
the same tent「同一頂帳篷」。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。

passages.zh: 班級露營時，我們晚餐後圍坐在營火旁。Jack 關掉手電筒說：「我來講個鬼故事。」大家都靠了過來。「很久以前，有個女孩在這座山裡迷路了，再也沒有人找到她。聽說到現在晚上還聽得到她的哭聲。」就在這時，樹林裡傳來一陣聲響！大家都尖叫起來，有些同學想馬上離開，跑回小木屋。接著一隻小動物從灌木叢裡走出來，原來只是一隻找食物的狸貓！大家都笑了，Jack 笑得最大聲。但那天晚上，沒有人敢自己睡。我們十二個人全擠在同一頂帳篷裡，誰也沒睡好。

passages.title: 黃色小鴨兄弟
passages.text: On the first day of the new school year, I wore my favorite T-shirt. It had a big yellow duck on it. When I walked into the classroom, I could not believe my eyes. Ken, the new boy, was wearing the {1} T-shirt! Everyone laughed and {2} us "the Duck Brothers." I felt so embarrassed. I wanted to {3} the classroom and go home. But Ken just smiled at me. "You have good taste," he said. We started to talk and found out that we like similar games and music. {4} lunch, we sat together and talked about our favorite cartoons. Now Ken is my best friend. We {5} wear our duck T-shirts on the same day sometimes, just for fun.

blanks.why: the same + 名詞「同一件、一樣的」：Ken 穿著一樣的 T 恤。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。
call + 人 + 稱呼「叫某人…」：大家叫我們「小鴨兄弟」。used、left、paid us 都不通。
leave + 地方「離開…」：我想離開教室回家。pay、feel、become the classroom 都不通。
during lunch「午餐時間」。Because 後面要接句子，Than、About 放在這裡不通。
still「仍然」：我們現在還是偶爾會在同一天穿小鴨 T 恤。enough、same、during 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 新學年的第一天，我穿了最喜歡的 T 恤，上面有一隻大大的黃色小鴨。走進教室時，我簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛：新同學 Ken 竟然穿著一模一樣的 T 恤！大家都笑了，叫我們「小鴨兄弟」。我覺得好尷尬，只想離開教室回家。但 Ken 只是對我笑笑：「你很有品味喔。」我們聊了起來，發現我們喜歡的遊戲和音樂都差不多。午餐時，我們坐在一起聊最喜歡的卡通。現在 Ken 是我最好的朋友，我們偶爾還是會在同一天穿小鴨 T 恤，只是為了好玩。

passages.title: 坐火車去花蓮
passages.text: Last weekend, my family took a train to Hualien. The train {1} Taipei at seven in the morning. I wanted to sleep, but the view was too beautiful. {2} the trip, I saw the blue sea on one side and green mountains on the other. In Hualien, we rented bikes and rode along the coast. The road was long, and the wind was strong. After two hours, my legs were tired, but my little brother wanted to keep going. "I am {3} full of energy!" he said. At lunch, we ate at a small restaurant. The owner gave us so much food. "Is this {4} for you?" she asked with a smile. We ate it all! I took many photos on this trip, and I will {5} them for my school project.

blanks.why: leave + 地方「從…出發」：火車早上七點從台北出發。used、called、felt Taipei 都不通。
during the trip「在旅途中」。Because 後面要接句子，Than、About 放在這裡不通。
still「仍然」：我還是精力充沛！enough、same、during 都不能放在 am 和形容詞中間。
enough「足夠的」：這樣夠你們吃嗎？same 前面要加 the，during、than 都不能這樣用。
use + 物 + for …「把…用在…」：我會把照片用在學校專題上。call、feel、pay them 都不通。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們全家搭火車去花蓮。火車早上七點從台北出發。我本來想睡覺，但風景實在太美了。一路上，一邊是藍色的大海，另一邊是青翠的高山。到了花蓮，我們租腳踏車沿著海岸騎。路很長，風也很大，騎了兩個小時後我的腿好痠，但弟弟還想繼續騎：「我還是精力充沛！」午餐時，我們在一家小餐廳吃飯，老闆娘給了我們好多菜，還笑著問：「這樣夠你們吃嗎？」我們全吃光了！這趟旅行我拍了很多照片，我要把它們用在學校的專題上。

passages.title: 籃球隊的暑假特訓
passages.text: Our school basketball team practices {1} every day. Coach Wang is very strict. "If you want to win, you have to work for it," he always says. {2} the summer vacation, we practiced from seven to eleven every morning. It was very hot, and we were always tired. One day, Andy wanted to {3} the team. "I'm not good {4}," he said. "I can never make a shot when it matters." Coach Wang did not get angry. Instead, he told Andy a {5} about Michael Jordan. "When he was young, he did not make his high school team. But he did not give up. He practiced every day." Andy thought about it for a long time and decided to stay. Now he is the best shooter on our team.

blanks.why: practice hard「努力練習」。same、still、during 都不能修飾 practices。
during + 時段「在…期間」：暑假期間每天早上練球。Because、Than、About 都不能這樣接時間。
leave the team「退出球隊」。use、pay、feel the team 都不通。
good enough「夠好」：enough 放在形容詞後面。same、during、still 都不能這樣用。
tell + 人 + a story「講故事給某人聽」。use、call、kind 都不能「講」。

passages.zh: 我們學校的籃球隊每天都努力練習。王教練非常嚴格，他總是說：「想贏，就要努力。」暑假期間，我們每天早上七點練到十一點，天氣非常熱，大家總是很累。有一天，Andy 想退出球隊：「我不夠好，關鍵時刻總是投不進。」王教練沒有生氣，而是跟他講了麥可‧喬丹的故事：「他年輕時沒有選上高中校隊，但他沒有放棄，每天都練習。」Andy 想了很久，決定留下來。現在他是我們隊上最好的射手。

passages.title: 灰姑娘的智慧型手機
passages.text: In this new {1}, Cinderella has a smartphone. One night, her stepsisters went to the prince's party, but Cinderella had to stay home and clean the kitchen. She felt very sad. Then her phone rang. It was her fairy godmother! "I have an {2}," she said. She sent Cinderella a beautiful dress and called a taxi for her with an app. "But you must {3} the party before midnight," she said. At the party, Cinderella danced with the prince all night. When the clock struck twelve, she ran away and dropped her phone on the stairs. The prince picked it up and {4} the number saved as "Home." Her stepmother answered, but the prince knew it was not the {5} voice. So he went to the house and found the real Cinderella.

blanks.why: a new story「一個新的故事」：在這個新版故事裡。use、call、kind 意思都不通。
have an idea「有個點子」。前面是 an，story、plan、kind 都要用 a。
leave the party「離開派對」。use、call、pay the party 都不通。
call the number「打那個號碼」。felt、paid、enjoyed the number 都不通。
the same voice「同一個聲音」：王子知道那不是同一個聲音。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。

passages.zh: 在這個新版故事裡，灰姑娘有一支智慧型手機。有天晚上，繼姊們去參加王子的派對，灰姑娘卻得留在家裡打掃廚房，她難過極了。這時她的手機響了，是神仙教母打來的！「我有個點子。」她說。她送給灰姑娘一件漂亮的禮服，還用 app 幫她叫了計程車。「但是你一定要在午夜前離開派對。」她說。派對上，灰姑娘和王子跳了一整晚的舞。鐘聲敲響十二下時，她跑走了，把手機掉在樓梯上。王子撿起手機，撥了存成「家」的那個號碼。接電話的是繼母，但王子知道那不是同一個聲音。於是他找到那棟房子，找到了真正的灰姑娘。

passages.title: 一天十分鐘的吉他
passages.text: Last year, I {1} my birthday money to buy a guitar. I thought playing the guitar would be easy, but it was really {2}. My fingers hurt, and the sound was terrible. My sister said it sounded like a sick cat! After two weeks, I wanted to give up. Then my music teacher gave me an {3}: "Practice for just ten minutes a day." Ten minutes did not sound like much, but it was {4}. Little by little, my fingers got stronger, and the sound got better. After six months, I could play five songs. {5} our school's Christmas party, I played a song in front of everyone. My hands were shaking, but I did not make any mistakes. Even my sister clapped for me!

blanks.why: use + 物 + to + 原形動詞「用…來做…」：我用生日紅包買了吉他。left、called、felt my birthday money 都不通。
hard「困難的」：彈吉他真的很難。same 前面要加 the，enough、during 都不能接在 really 後面。
give + 人 + an idea「給某人一個點子」。前面是 an，story、plan、kind 都要用 a。
enough「足夠的」：十分鐘聽起來不多，但已經夠了。same 前要加 the，during、than 都不能放在 was 後面。
during + 名詞「在…期間」：在學校的聖誕派對上。Because、Than、About 都不能這樣接名詞表時間。

passages.zh: 去年，我用生日紅包買了一把吉他。我以為彈吉他很簡單，沒想到真的很難：手指好痛，聲音也很難聽，姊姊說聽起來像一隻生病的貓！兩個星期後，我就想放棄了。這時音樂老師給了我一個點子：「一天只要練十分鐘就好。」十分鐘聽起來不多，但已經足夠了。一點一點地，我的手指變得更有力，聲音也愈來愈好聽。六個月後，我已經會彈五首歌。在學校的聖誕派對上，我在大家面前彈了一首歌。我的手在發抖，但一個錯都沒有。就連姊姊也為我拍手！

passages.title: 給媽媽的生日影片
passages.text: Mom's birthday was on Sunday. My brother and I wanted to give her a surprise, but we did not have {1} money for a big present. Then my brother said, "Let's make a video for her!" It was a great {2}. We {3} Mom's old friends and asked them to say something to her. Some of them had not seen her for twenty years! We also {4} old photos from our family albums. We worked on the video late at night, so Mom would not see. On her birthday, we played it on the TV. When Mom saw her old friends, she cried and laughed at the same time. "This is the best present I have ever gotten," she said. She {5} watches the video when she misses her friends.

blanks.why: enough money「足夠的錢」。same 前要加 the，during、still 不能修飾 money。
a great idea「好主意」。news、money、homework 是不可數名詞，不能加 a。
call + 人「打電話給某人」：我們打電話給媽媽的老朋友。used、left、paid Mom's old friends 都不通。
use old photos「使用舊照片」：我們也用了相簿裡的老照片。paid、called、felt old photos 都不通。
still「仍然」：她到現在想念朋友時還會看這支影片。enough、same、during 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 媽媽的生日在星期天。我和哥哥想給她一個驚喜，但我們沒有足夠的錢買大禮物。這時哥哥說：「我們幫她做一支影片吧！」真是個好主意。我們打電話給媽媽的老朋友，請他們對媽媽說幾句話，有些人已經二十年沒見過她了！我們也用了家裡相簿的老照片。我們都在深夜做影片，免得被媽媽看到。生日那天，我們在電視上播放影片。媽媽看到老朋友們時，又哭又笑。「這是我收過最棒的禮物。」她說。直到現在，她想念朋友時還會拿出這支影片來看。

passages.title: 故宮裡的小蟲
passages.text: Last Saturday, our class visited the National Palace Museum. Our guide was an old man with white hair, and he told us a {1} about every treasure. The most famous one is the Jadeite Cabbage. "Look carefully," he said. "There are two insects on the leaves. Can you find them?" It was {2} to see them at first, but finally I found them. They looked so real! {3} the tour, we were not allowed to take photos, so I drew pictures in my notebook. The museum was so big that we could not see everything in one day. We had to {4} at four o'clock because the bus was waiting. But I {5} want to go back. Next time, I will bring my parents and be their guide.

blanks.why: tell + 人 + a story「講故事給某人聽」：導覽員每件寶物都講一個故事。use、call、kind 都不能「講」。
It is hard to + 原形動詞「…很困難」：一開始很難看到。same 前要加 the，still、during 不能這樣用。
during the tour「參觀期間」。Because 後面要接句子，Than、About 放在這裡不通。
leave「離開」：我們四點就得離開。use、feel、enjoy at four o'clock 都不通（後面都需要受詞）。
still「仍然」：我還是想再去。enough、same、during 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我們班去參觀故宮博物院。導覽員是一位白髮老先生，每件寶物他都講了一個故事給我們聽。最有名的是翠玉白菜。「仔細看，」他說，「葉子上有兩隻昆蟲，你們找得到嗎？」一開始很難看出來，但最後我找到了，牠們看起來好逼真！參觀時不能拍照，所以我在筆記本上畫圖。博物院太大了，一天根本看不完，因為巴士在等，我們四點就得離開。但我還是很想再去。下次我要帶爸媽去，當他們的導覽員。

passages.title: 地震演習
passages.text: Last Friday, our school had an earthquake drill. At ten o'clock, the alarm rang loudly. Our teacher shouted, "Get under your desks!" We held the legs of our desks and had to stay {1} for one minute. Then our teacher told us to {2} the classroom. We {3} our books to cover our heads and walked to the playground in a line. Nobody ran, and nobody talked. It took our class three minutes to get there. Our principal said, "Good job, everyone. But three minutes is not fast {4}. Next time, try to do it in two." Some students thought the drill was boring. But our teacher said, "{5} a real earthquake, every second matters. That is why we practice."

blanks.why: stay still「保持不動」：我們得一動也不動地待一分鐘。stay enough、stay same、stay during 都不通（「保持一樣」要說 stay the same）。
leave the classroom「離開教室」。feel、call、pay the classroom 都不通。
use + 物 + to + 原形動詞「用…來做…」：我們用書本護著頭。paid、called、felt our books 都不通。
fast enough「夠快」：enough 放在形容詞後面。same、during、still 都不能這樣用。
during + 名詞「在…期間」：真正地震時，每一秒都很重要。Because 後面要接句子，Than、About 放在這裡不通。

passages.zh: 上星期五，我們學校舉行地震演習。十點時，警報聲大響，老師大喊：「躲到桌子底下！」我們抓住桌腳，一動也不動地待了一分鐘。接著老師叫我們離開教室。我們用書本護住頭，排成一列走到操場。沒有人奔跑，也沒有人說話，我們班花了三分鐘才到。校長說：「大家做得很好，但三分鐘還不夠快，下次試著在兩分鐘內完成。」有些同學覺得演習很無聊，但老師說：「真正地震的時候，每一秒都很重要，所以我們才要練習。」

passages.title: 迷路的送貨機器人
passages.text: Last month, a new robot started to work in our apartment building. It brings food and packages to people's doors. To get your package, you just {1} your phone to open the robot's box. The robot is very cute. It sings a song when it arrives. My little brother {2} it "Little Rice." One day, the robot got lost. It went to the twelfth floor instead of the twenty-first floor. After ten minutes, it {3} could not find our door. So my brother went out to look for it. He found it in front of the elevator, singing the {4} song again and again. The company fixed it the next day, and now it never gets lost. But my brother is a little sad. "I liked it better when it was lost," he said. It is a funny {5} that our family likes to tell.

blanks.why: use + 物 + to + 原形動詞：用手機打開機器人的箱子。leave、feel、pay your phone 都不通。
call + 人／物 + 名字「叫…為…」：弟弟叫它「小米」。uses、leaves、pays it 都不通。
still「仍然」：過了十分鐘，它還是找不到我們家。enough、same、during 都不能放在主詞和 could 中間。
the same song「同一首歌」。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。
a funny story「好笑的故事」。use、call、kind 意思都不通。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們的公寓大樓來了一台新的機器人，它會把餐點和包裹送到每戶門口。要拿包裹，只要用手機就能打開機器人的箱子。這台機器人很可愛，到達時會唱歌，弟弟叫它「小米」。有一天，機器人迷路了，它跑到十二樓，而不是二十一樓。過了十分鐘，它還是找不到我們家。於是弟弟出去找它，結果在電梯前面找到它，它正一遍又一遍地唱著同一首歌。公司隔天就把它修好了，現在它再也不會迷路。但弟弟有點難過：「我比較喜歡它迷路的時候。」這是我們家很愛講的一個好笑故事。

passages.title: 史瑞克的驚喜派對
passages.text: Shrek lived alone in a swamp, and he did not like visitors. One day, Donkey came up with a crazy {1}: "Let's have a surprise birthday party for Shrek!" He {2} all their friends, and they came the next afternoon. They decorated the swamp with flowers and made a big mud cake. When Shrek came home, everyone shouted, "Surprise!" Shrek was angry at first. "I told you, I like to be alone!" he said. He turned around and wanted to {3}. But then he saw the mud cake. It was his favorite! He tried very {4} not to smile, but he could not. In the end, he danced and sang all night. "Can we do this again next year," he asked quietly, "on the {5} day?"

blanks.why: a crazy idea「瘋狂的點子」。news、money、homework 都是不可數名詞，不能加 a。
call + 人「打電話給某人」：驢子打電話給所有朋友。used、left、paid all their friends 都不通。
leave「離開」：他轉身想走。use、call、pay 後面都需要受詞，放在這裡不通。
try hard not to + 原形動詞「努力忍著不…」。same、enough、during 都不能接在 tried very 後面。
on the same day「在同一天」。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。

gloss: 史瑞克（電影《史瑞克》的主角）
passages.zh: 史瑞克一個人住在沼澤裡，他不喜歡有人來拜訪。有一天，驢子想到一個瘋狂的點子：「我們幫史瑞克辦一個驚喜生日派對吧！」他打電話給所有朋友，大家隔天下午都來了。他們用花朵裝飾沼澤，還做了一個大大的泥巴蛋糕。史瑞克回家時，大家大喊：「驚喜！」史瑞克一開始很生氣：「我跟你們說過，我喜歡一個人！」他轉身就想走。但接著他看到那個泥巴蛋糕，那是他的最愛！他很努力地忍住不笑，卻還是忍不住。最後，他整晚又唱又跳。「明年可以再辦一次嗎？」他小聲地問，「在同一天？」

passages.title: 用 AI 寫作業
passages.text: Our English teacher, Ms. Lee, asked us to write a {1} about a hero. Leo did not want to do it, so he {2} an AI app to write it. In one minute, the story was done, and it was perfect. The next day, Ms. Lee read everyone's homework. When she read Leo's, she smiled. "This is very good," she said. "But I read the {3} story in Tom's homework." Leo's face turned red. Tom had used that app too! Ms. Lee was not angry. "AI is a useful tool," she said, "but your own {4} are more important. I want to read what you think." So Leo wrote a new story by himself. It took him three hours, and it was {5} work. It was not perfect, but it was his, and Ms. Lee liked it very much.

blanks.why: write a story「寫故事」。use、call、kind 都不能「寫」，意思不通。
use an app「使用應用程式」：Leo 用 AI app 幫他寫。felt、left、enjoyed an AI app to write it 都不通。
the same story「同一個故事」。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。
your own ideas「你自己的想法」。calls、uses、kinds 意思都不通。
hard work「辛苦的工作」。same 前要加 the，still、during 不能修飾 work。

passages.zh: 英文老師李老師要我們寫一個關於英雄的故事。Leo 不想寫，就用了一個 AI app 幫他寫。一分鐘後，故事就完成了，而且寫得很完美。隔天，李老師讀了大家的作業，讀到 Leo 的時候，她笑了：「這篇寫得很好，但我在 Tom 的作業裡也讀到同一個故事。」Leo 的臉一下子紅了，原來 Tom 也用了那個 app！李老師沒有生氣：「AI 是很有用的工具，但你們自己的想法更重要。我想讀的是你們的想法。」於是 Leo 自己寫了一個新故事，花了他三個小時，很辛苦。故事並不完美，但那是他自己的，李老師非常喜歡。

passages.title: 不一樣的新年
passages.text: Our school has many students from other countries. {1} English class, Ms. Lin asked us, "How do you celebrate the New Year?" Linh from Vietnam said, "We have Tet. It is usually on the {2} day as Chinese New Year!" Kenji from Japan said, "We eat long noodles and visit temples." Sam from America said, "We watch a big ball drop in New York. At midnight, we {3} our friends and say, 'Happy New Year!'" Then Ms. Lin had an {4}: "Let's have an international New Year party!" The next week, everyone brought food from home. There were rice cakes, sushi, and apple pie. I learned that people celebrate in different ways, but their wish is {5} the same: a happy and healthy new year.

blanks.why: during + 名詞「在…期間」：英文課上。Because 後面要接句子，Than、About 放在這裡不通。
on the same day as …「和…在同一天」。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。
call + 人「打電話給某人」。use、save、feel our friends 都不通。
have an idea「有個點子」。前面是 an，story、plan、kind 都要用 a。
still「仍然、還是」：大家的願望還是一樣的。enough、during、than 都不能放在 is 和 the same 中間。

passages.zh: 我們學校有很多來自其他國家的學生。英文課上，林老師問我們：「你們怎麼慶祝新年？」來自越南的 Linh 說：「我們過越南新年，通常和農曆新年在同一天！」來自日本的健二說：「我們吃長長的麵，還去寺廟參拜。」來自美國的 Sam 說：「我們看紐約的大球降下。到了午夜，我們會打電話給朋友說『新年快樂！』」接著林老師想到一個點子：「我們來辦一場國際新年派對吧！」下個星期，大家都從家裡帶了食物來：有年糕、壽司，還有蘋果派。我學到了：大家慶祝的方式不一樣，但願望還是相同的——一個快樂又健康的新年。

passages.title: 走失的哈士奇
passages.text: On my way home from school, I saw a big husky walking alone on the street. There was no owner with it. It had a name tag that said "Snow," and there was a phone number on it. I {1} the number right away. A woman answered. She was crying. "Snow ran away this morning! I looked for him all day." She asked me to wait for her, and I did not want to {2} him alone. {3} the next thirty minutes, we played with a ball in the park. It was getting dark, but Snow {4} wanted to play. When the woman arrived, Snow jumped on her and licked her face. "Thank you so much!" she said. It was {5} to say goodbye, but she promised to send me photos of Snow every week.

blanks.why: call the number「撥那個號碼」。enjoyed、left、felt the number 都不通。
leave + 人／動物 + alone「留下…獨自一個」：我不想丟下牠不管。use、feel、pay him alone 都不通。
during + 時段「在…期間」：接下來的三十分鐘裡。Because、Than、About 都不能這樣接時間。
still「仍然」：天快黑了，Snow 還是想玩。enough、same、during 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。
It is hard to + 原形動詞「…很難」：要說再見很難。same 前要加 the，still、during 不能這樣用。

passages.zh: 放學回家的路上，我看到一隻大哈士奇獨自走在街上，身邊沒有主人。牠的名牌上寫著「Snow」，還有一個電話號碼。我馬上撥了那個號碼，接電話的女士在哭：「Snow 今天早上跑掉了！我找了一整天。」她請我等她，我也不想丟下牠不管。接下來的三十分鐘，我們在公園裡玩球。天色漸漸暗了，Snow 卻還是想玩。女士一到，Snow 就撲到她身上舔她的臉。「真的太謝謝你了！」她說。要說再見很難，但她答應每個星期都會傳 Snow 的照片給我。

passages.title: 瑪利歐的最後一關
passages.text: My cousin and I love playing Super Mario. Last weekend, we tried to finish the last level of the game. It was really {1}. We died again and again at the {2} place: a big jump over a lake of fire. After two hours, we were {3} not able to pass it. My cousin threw the controller on the sofa. "This game is impossible!" he shouted. Then he had an {4}: "Let's watch a video online." In the video, we learned that you can {5} a hidden mushroom to fly over the fire. We tried it, and it worked! When we finally saw the princess, we jumped and screamed. My mom ran into the room. She thought something was wrong. We laughed and told her, "Mom, we saved the princess!"

blanks.why: hard「困難的」：最後一關真的很難。same 前要加 the，enough、during 都不能接在 really 後面。
the same place「同一個地方」。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。
still「仍然」：兩個小時後我們還是過不了。enough、same、during 都不能放在 were 和 not 中間。
have an idea「有個點子」。前面是 an，story、plan、kind 都要用 a。
use + 物 + to + 原形動詞：可以用隱藏的蘑菇飛過火焰。leave、call、pay a hidden mushroom 都不通。

passages.zh: 我和表哥很愛玩超級瑪利歐。上週末，我們想破最後一關，那一關真的好難。我們一次又一次死在同一個地方：要跳過一片火焰湖。兩個小時後，我們還是過不了關。表哥把手把丟到沙發上大叫：「這遊戲根本不可能過！」接著他想到一個點子：「我們上網看影片吧。」從影片裡我們學到，可以用一個隱藏的蘑菇飛過火焰。我們試了一下，真的成功了！終於看到公主時，我們又跳又叫，媽媽衝進房間，以為發生了什麼事。我們笑著跟她說：「媽，我們救到公主了！」

passages.title: 畢業紀念冊
passages.text: Graduation is coming soon. {1} the last month of school, everyone is busy writing in each other's yearbooks. Ms. Wu asked each of us to write a short {2} about our best day in junior high. I wrote about our school trip in seventh grade. That day, our bus broke down on a mountain road, so we sang songs by the road for two hours. When I read my friends' yearbook pages, I laughed. They all wrote about the {3} trip! It is funny. We did not like it at that time, but now it is our favorite memory. Our class will {4} this school in June, and we will go to different high schools. But I hope we can {5} be friends for many years.

blanks.why: during + 時段「在…期間」：在最後一個月裡。Because、Than、About 都不能這樣接時間。
write a short story「寫一篇短短的故事」。use、call、kind 都不能「寫」。
the same trip「同一次旅行」。enough、during、than 都不能放在 the 和名詞中間。
leave + 地方「離開…」：我們班六月就要離開這所學校。use、call、pay this school 都不通。
still「仍然」：希望我們還能當很多年的朋友。enough、same、during 都不能放在 can 和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 畢業的日子快到了。在最後一個月裡，大家都忙著在彼此的畢業紀念冊上寫字。吳老師要我們每個人寫一篇短短的故事，記下國中最棒的一天。我寫的是七年級的校外教學：那天，我們的巴士在山路上拋錨，大家就在路邊唱了兩個小時的歌。讀到朋友們寫的那一頁時，我笑了出來，原來大家寫的都是同一次旅行！真有趣，那時候我們一點都不喜歡，現在卻成了最喜歡的回憶。我們班六月就要離開這所學校，各自去不同的高中，但我希望我們還能當很多年的朋友。

passages.title: 五百元料理大賽
passages.text: Our school held a cooking contest. Each team had one hour and 500 dollars to make lunch for twenty people. My team wanted to make beef noodles, but 500 dollars was not {1} for beef. So we changed our plan. We {2} eggs, tomatoes, and noodles instead. Cooking for twenty people was {3}. Ben cut his finger, and Amy burned the first pot of soup. {4} the last ten minutes, we ran around the kitchen like crazy. Finally, we finished just in time. Our dish looked simple next to the other teams' fried chicken and curry. In the end, we did not win, but one of the judges said she liked our {5} of making a cheap and healthy meal. She even asked us for the recipe!

blanks.why: not enough「不夠」：五百元不夠買牛肉。same 前要加 the，during、still 放在這裡都不通。
use + 物「使用…」：我們改用蛋、番茄和麵。left、called、felt eggs 都不通。
hard「辛苦的、困難的」：煮二十人份很辛苦。same 前要加 the，still、during 都不能放在 was 後面當形容詞。
during + 時段「在…期間」：最後十分鐘。Because、Than、About 都不能這樣接時間。
one's idea of + V-ing「…的點子」：評審喜歡我們做便宜又健康餐點的點子。use、kind、leave of making 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們學校舉辦了一場料理比賽，每隊有一個小時和五百元，要做出二十人份的午餐。我們隊本來想做牛肉麵，但五百元不夠買牛肉，所以我們改變計畫，改用蛋、番茄和麵條。煮二十人份真的好難：Ben 切到手指，Amy 把第一鍋湯燒焦了。最後十分鐘，我們在廚房裡忙得團團轉，終於及時完成。和其他隊的炸雞、咖哩比起來，我們的菜看起來很簡單。最後我們沒有得獎，但一位評審說她很喜歡我們做便宜又健康餐點的點子，甚至還跟我們要了食譜！

passages.title: 半夜的綠光
passages.text: One night, I could not sleep, so I looked out of the window. There was a strange light in the sky. It was round and green, and it stayed {1} for five minutes. I wanted to {2} my best friend, but it was two in the morning. Then the light came closer and landed in the park! A small green alien came out. It looked at me and waved. I was scared, but I waved back. It said something, but I could not understand it. So I {3} a translation app on my phone. "I am lost," the alien said. "Can you help me find the moon?" I pointed at the sky. It said, "Thank you!" and flew away. The next morning, I told my family the {4}, but nobody believed me. My sister said it was just a dream. But in the park, there was a big round hole in the grass. Now I have an {5}: tonight, I will stay up and wait with my camera.

blanks.why: stay still「靜止不動」：綠光五分鐘都沒有動。stay enough、stay same、stay during 都不通。
call + 人「打電話給某人」。use、leave、pay my best friend 都不通。
use an app「使用 app」：我用手機上的翻譯 app。left、called、felt a translation app 都不通。
tell + 人 + the story「把這件事告訴某人」。use、call、kind 都不能「講」。
have an idea「有個點子」。前面是 an，story、plan、kind 都要用 a。

passages.zh: 有一天晚上我睡不著，就往窗外看。天空中有一道奇怪的光，又圓又綠，靜靜地停了五分鐘。我想打電話給最好的朋友，但那時是凌晨兩點。接著，那道光愈來愈近，降落在公園裡！一個綠色的小外星人走了出來，看著我揮手。我很害怕，但還是揮手回應。它說了些話，我聽不懂，於是我用了手機上的翻譯 app。「我迷路了，」外星人說，「你能幫我找月亮嗎？」我指了指天空，它說：「謝謝！」就飛走了。隔天早上，我把這件事告訴家人，卻沒有人相信，姊姊說那只是一場夢。但公園的草地上，真的有一個大大的圓洞。現在我有個點子：今晚我要帶著相機熬夜等它。
